import ctypes as C
c=C.CDLL('libcairo.so.2')
def api(n,rest,args):
 f=getattr(c,n);f.restype=rest;f.argtypes=args;return f
p=C.c_void_p;d=C.c_double;i=C.c_int
s=api('cairo_image_surface_create',p,[i,i,i])(0,800,300)
cr=api('cairo_create',p,[p])(s)
api('cairo_select_font_face',None,[p,C.c_char_p,i,i])(cr,b'Noto Serif Display',0,0)
api('cairo_set_font_size',None,[p,d])(cr,108)
class E(C.Structure):_fields_=[(n,d) for n in ['x_bearing','y_bearing','width','height','x_advance','y_advance']]
e=E();api('cairo_text_extents',None,[p,C.c_char_p,C.POINTER(E)])(cr,b'Fernway',C.byref(e))
print({n:getattr(e,n) for n,_ in e._fields_})
PY"

item.text: The logo is drawn, and the icon stays legible in the 16px preview. I’m checking the final SVGs and polishing the leaf joins; all lettering is outlined so the files won’t depend on installed fonts.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='/tmp/fernway-logo-review/build.py'
s=open(p).read().replace('M11 29 C12 23 12 16 12 10 L15 10 C15 17 15 24 14 29 Z', 'M11 29 C12 23 12 16 12 13 L15 13 C15 17 15 24 14 29 Z')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python3 /tmp/fernway-logo-review/build.py
python3 .agents/skills/interface-design/scripts/color.py contrast '#234b3b' '#f5f0e5'
python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
ns={'s':'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
for name in ('logo.svg', 'mark.svg'):
 p=Path(name)
 root=ET.parse(p).getroot()
 assert root.attrib['viewBox'] == ('0 0 736 240' if name=='logo.svg' else '0 0 32 32')
 assert not root.findall('.//s:text', ns)
 assert not root.findall('.//s:image', ns)
 assert not root.findall('.//s:script', ns)
 assert all('href' not in k for el in root.iter() for k in el.attrib)
 assert len(root.findall('.//s:path', ns)) == (6 if name=='logo.svg' else 4)
 print(f'{name}: valid self-contained SVG, all outlines, {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes')
PY"
